items.html: The general conclusion is that the two Mochin of Hochma and Bina of ZA are drops drawn from the two upper segments of Hesed and Gevura of Arich Anpin. They are their illumination and not their very selves; and within these drops is also clothed the illumination of the two upper segments of Netzah and Hod of Atik Yomin, hidden within the two upper segments of Hesed and Gevura of Arich Anpin, as above — and not their very selves. But Daat, the third brain of ZA, is from the two lower segments of Hesed and Gevura of Arich Anpin — their very selves and not their illumination, except that they are clothed in the Mochin of Aba and Ima. And within these two segments of Hesed and Gevura of Arich Anpin there also descended the two lower segments of Netzah and Hod of Atik Yomin, hidden within them — their very selves and not their illumination.
